'''Plakot''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Qunaalac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] who lived during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Plakot was one of the main [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]], the leader of the Qunaalac clan. Plakot oversaw Qunaalac's legitimate manufacturing operations, which were used as a cover for the clan's counterfeit merchandise business. She often negotiated with Qunaalac's rival Hutt clans for support and smoothed over disagreements that arose due to the aggressive style that Qunaalac frequently demonstrated in its business dealings.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
